en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a neoclassical building, partially obscured by trees, with a path leading up to the entrance. The building features symmetrical architecture, rectangular windows with rounded tops, and a prominent plaque above the main entrance. There is a cross and ornate decoration atop the pediment, signifying religious significance. A single person stands in front of the door, adding a sense of scale.
